pages.title: The Amethyst Colossus
pages.text: The Barrens hum because something in them is still singing. Gather enough crystal in one place, strike the right note, and the song takes shape: a giant of living amethyst.$(br2)It does not hate you. It simply does not stop.
A Resonant Core: the note that calls it.

pages.name: Ritual of Resonance
pages.text: Candles on each side, and Amethyst Blocks everywhere else: two out on each diagonal, three out on each side and each diagonal.

pages.title: Fighting It
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Arrows glance off its crystal.$() Magic, and lightning above all, cuts deep.$(li)It fires crystal lances, and its resonance pulse throws everything near it back.$(li)When it is wounded, the ground $(l)erupts$() beneath you. Move when it glows.$(li)Near the end it hardens into a shield. Wait it out.

pages.title: The Resonant Prism
pages.text: What remains of its heart. Held in your $(l)other hand$(), your spells recharge $(l)25% faster$().$(br2)The first time you silence the Colossus, its song settles in you: $(l)+100 maximum mana$(), forever.
